description: This Dart source file defines an API client for authentication-related endpoints, including login, signup, OTP verification, token refresh, and password reset functionalities. It also includes an exception class for handling API errors.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception for API error handling, including message and optional status code.

classes.name: AuthApi
classes.description: A client class encapsulating methods to interact with authentication endpoints of a backend API, with functions for login, signup, OTP verification, token refresh, and password reset.

methods.name: _postJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with JSON-encoded body to the specified API endpoint and handles response validation.

methods.name: loginWithPassword
methods.description: Sends login request with phone or email and password to authenticate user.

methods.name: requestOtp
methods.description: Requests an OTP for login or signup via phone.

methods.name: verifyOtp
methods.description: Verifies OTP for login or signup process.

methods.name: signupWithPassword
methods.description: Handles user registration with password, including optional name and consent acceptance.

methods.name: refreshToken
methods.description: Requests a new access token using a refresh token.

methods.name: passwordResetRequest
methods.description: Initiates a password reset process by requesting a reset code.

methods.name: passwordResetConfirm
methods.description: Confirms password reset with OTP and new password.
